AboutMeSection.studentParagraph: I am a Computer Science student at <highlight>Poznań University of Technology</highlight> and an active member of the <highlight>AKAI</highlight> scientific circle. I specialize in creating web applications and other software. I deliver projects <highlight>end-to-end</highlight>, taking responsibility for every stage: from design, through coding, to configuration and deployment in a production environment.
AboutMeSection.technologyParagraph: Most often, I use <highlight>JavaScript and TypeScript</highlight> in my projects, but I am not afraid of other technologies such as <highlight>Java and Python</highlight>. I also have a solid understanding of <highlight>SQL and NoSQL</highlight> databases, which I commonly use in my work.

HorizonsSection.deploymentParagraph: Continuous development is important to me, which is why I don't limit myself to web technologies. One of the most interesting areas for me is the <highlight>DevOps</highlight> role. I am not intimidated by the <highlight>Linux</highlight> command line or configuring the tools necessary for projects to run. All of this is strongly tied to security. I make sure that my applications and projects are not exposed to external threats.
HorizonsSection.otherTechnologiesParagraph: JavaScript and TypeScript are not everything, so other languages like <highlight>Java, Python, and C++</highlight> are no strangers to me. I have completed projects using <highlight>Spring Boot, Flask, and PyTorch</highlight>. I don't limit myself solely to software either. Tinkering with platforms like <highlight>Raspberry Pi and Arduino</highlight> has brought me a lot of fun and allowed me to face the challenges generated by the hardware itself.

AfterHoursSection.paragraph: Programming is not everything to me. Teamwork and having a good time are also important, which is why I am a member of the <highlight>AKAI</highlight> scientific circle, which brings together enthusiasts with similar interests. Besides that, I attend hackathons with friends, where my biggest success has been reaching two finals of the largest event of its kind in Europe - <highlight>HackYeah</highlight>.
